⌁ YOUR CAMERA. YOUR DEVICE. YOUR MOMENT. Video is never recorded or uploaded.

Thousands of characters, one curious eye. The iris is drawn live, with a little breathing, a natural blink, and a gaze that eases into place.

Camera mode follows a face. It keeps its attention on the same face while visible, and chooses the largest face when finding someone new. Keep your face well lit and within a few feet of the camera. If you step away, it looks around until you return.

Face detection uses Google's MediaPipe entirely inside your browser. No images leave your device. Switching to Pointer or Autopilot turns the camera off. Camera access needs HTTPS or localhost and your browser's permission.
